props.name: items
props.description: Required. The pairs, in the order people read them.

props.name: columns
props.description: How many columns at full width. It drops to one when the container is narrower than 28rem.

props.name: className
props.description: On the container.

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the container.

props.name: term (DescriptionListItem)
props.description: Required. The field name: "Serial".

props.name: description (DescriptionListItem)
props.description: Required. Its value.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: A short list of actions behind a button. It uses the same background as Select, so the system's two pop-ups look like one family. The highlighted item gets a fill, as it does everywhere else.
components.useWhen: A short list of actions, under about eight, behind a button.

props.name: open (Root)
props.description: Whether the menu is open, when the page keeps track of it (controlled).

props.name: defaultOpen (Root)
props.description: Whether it starts open, when the menu keeps track itself (uncontrolled).

props.name: onOpenChange (Root)
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: modal (Root)
props.description: While open, keyboard focus stays inside the menu and the page behind can't scroll.

props.name: align (Content)
props.description: Alignment against the trigger.

props.name: side (Content)
props.description: Preferred side of the trigger.

props.name: sideOffset (Content)
props.description: Gap between trigger and content, in pixels.

props.name: onSelect (Item)
props.description: Called when the item is chosen.

props.name: disabled (Item)
props.description: The item can't be chosen, and typing letters (typeahead) skips it.

props.name: tone (Item)
props.description: Use hostile for a destructive action: hostile-coloured text at rest, the hostile fill with ink text when highlighted.

props.name: asChild (Item)
props.description: Makes the one child (a link) the item, for a menu of links. icon and shortcut are ignored then; put the content inside the link.

props.name: icon (Item)
props.description: A small icon before the text, hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden).

props.name: shortcut (Item)
props.description: Shown on the right and passed to screen readers as aria-keyshortcuts. It only displays the key: the menu never makes the key work.

props.name: checked (Checkbox item)
props.description: Whether the tick shows.

props.name: onCheckedChange (Checkbox item)
props.description: Called when the checkbox item is toggled.

props.name: value (RadioGroup)
props.description: The checked radio item.

props.name: onValueChange (RadioGroup)
props.description: Called with the chosen radio item value.

props.name: value (RadioItem)
props.description: This radio item's own value.

props.name: icon (SubTrigger)
props.description: A small icon before the text, hidden from screen readers, as on Item.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange (Sub)
props.description: Whether the submenu is open, tracked by the page (controlled) or by the submenu (uncontrolled). You'll usually leave these alone.

props.name: alignOffset (SubContent)
props.description: Shifts the submenu so its first row lines up with its trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged with the part's own. When two Tailwind classes clash, the later one wins. Every part takes it.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the rendered element (the DOM node). On Content, Item, Checkbox item, Radio item, Sub trigger and Sub content.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a list, a table or a page region shows when it has nothing in it: an icon, a title that names what is empty, a sentence on why, and the action that fills it.
components.useWhen: A list, table or region with nothing in it, along with the action that fills it.

props.name: title
props.description: Required. What is empty, said plainly: “No orders yet”.

props.name: level
props.description: Required, with no default. The heading level the page's outline of headings needs at this point.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences: why it's empty, or what fills it.

props.name: icon
props.description: A lucide icon element. The component sizes it and wraps it in a tile that screen readers skip (aria-hidden).

props.name: actions
props.description: One or two Buttons. The component lays out the row and its gap.

props.name: size
props.description: md for a page region. sm inside a table, a card or a panel.

props.name: framed
props.description: The dashed frame. Turn it off where the container already draws an edge.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged onto the outer element. When two Tailwind classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the outer element.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Any other div attribute, put on the outer element. role="status" goes here when nothing else on the page tells screen readers that the list has emptied.

components.name: FormField
components.summary: The label, help text and error text for one form control. They're connected so a screen reader reads all three, in that order, when the control gets focus. The atoms (the smallest components) never label themselves. This is where it happens.
components.useWhen: The label, help and error for an Input, Textarea, Select, MultiSelect or QuantityStepper.

props.name: label
props.description: The field label. Required.

props.name: help
props.description: Instruction text, read out before any error.

props.name: error
props.description: Sets invalid on the control and adds the error line.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the asterisk (hidden from screen readers) and the built-in required attribute on the control. That attribute is what assistive technology actually announces.

props.name: children
props.description: Exactly one control: Input, Textarea, Select, MultiSelect, QuantityStepper, DatePicker, DateRangePicker or TimeField. The controls that name themselves (all but Input and Textarea) take the FormField label, so leave their own label out. An id you give the control is kept (point an ErrorSummary entry at it); without one, FormField makes one up.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged with the outer element's own. When two Tailwind classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the outer element.

props.name: errors (ErrorSummary)
props.description: What stopped the form from submitting, in the order of the fields. Each entry links to its field and moves focus there. An empty list shows nothing.

props.name: title (ErrorSummary)
props.description: The heading. It's what a screen reader reads first when the form moves focus to the summary.

props.name: headingLevel (ErrorSummary)
props.description: The heading level, so the summary fits the outline of headings on its page.

props.name: className (ErrorSummary)
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged with the outer element's own. When two Tailwind classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref (ErrorSummary)
props.description: The summary itself. A form moves focus to it after a submit that failed.

components.name: ListItem
components.summary: One row of a list: something at the start (a picture or icon), a title and description, extra details on the right, and actions at the end. A row that goes somewhere is one real link or button stretched over the whole row. Its actions sit beside it, never inside it.
components.useWhen: A row people scan in a List: media, a title, meta and one or two actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Required. The main line, and the name screen readers give the row’s link or button.

props.name: description
props.description: A second line under the title, in secondary text.

props.name: media
props.description: Something at the start of the row: an Avatar, an icon (hidden from screen readers with aria-hidden), a thumbnail.

props.name: meta
props.description: Right-aligned monospaced text: a time, a price, a count.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end. Each one can still be focused and clicked on its own.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the row one link to this address, named by the title.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Draws the row link when href is set. Pass your router's link here. It has to pass className through.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Makes the row one button, named by the title. Ignored when href is set.

props.name: as
props.description: li inside a List. div for a row on its own.

props.name: dividers (List)
props.description: A thin line between rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged with the outer element's own classes on List or ListItem.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the ul (List) or the row element (ListItem).

components.name: MultiSelect
components.summary: Pick several choices from a list. The chosen ones sit inside the field as tags you can remove, followed by a text field that filters the list as you type. It's the many-values version of Select.
components.useWhen: Any number of choices, including none, from a list too long to show all at once.

props.name: label
props.description: The name screen readers give the text field and the list. Leave it out inside a FormField, which sets it from its own label. Outside one it is required, and `division-ds check` flags a missing one.

props.name: options
props.description: { value, label, disabled? }, the same rows Select takes.

props.name: value
props.description: The current selection when the page keeps track of it (controlled), as option values in the order they were chosen.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting selection when the component keeps track itself (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs with the whole new array every time an option is added or removed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is chosen.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown in the panel when the typed text matches no option.

props.name: inputSize
props.description: Matches Input and Select: a minimum height of 32, 40 or 48px (pixels), with text at size xs, sm or base. It also sets the size of the typed text and of the option rows in the list (28, 32 or 40px). The tags come in one size, so sm fits a single row of them snugly, and md and lg add room around it. The field grows past the minimum as tags wrap.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Sets aria-invalid (which tells screen readers the value has a problem) and the invalid border. FormField sets it from error.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the field off. The chosen tags stay visible, without their remove buttons.

props.name: required
props.description: Sets aria-required on the text field, so screen readers say it's required.

props.name: name
props.description: Sends each chosen value with the form as its own hidden input under this name.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged onto the field.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the text field.

props.name: id
props.description: The text field’s id. FormField sets it.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ids of the help and error text, put on the text field so screen readers read them. FormField sets it.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The top of a screen. It holds the page’s one h1 (the main, level-1 heading), and can add an eyebrow, a description, a breadcrumb trail and the page’s own actions at the far edge.
components.useWhen: The top of every screen: its one h1, with eyebrow, description, breadcrumbs and page actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Required. The page’s name, shown as its h1.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short label above the title: the area the page belongs to.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: The page’s own actions, usually one or two Buttons. The component lays out the row and its gap.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: A Breadcrumbs element, drawn above the eyebrow.

props.name: id
props.description: Goes on the h1, not the wrapper, so main can point aria-labelledby at it. That ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) attribute lets the main area take its name from the heading.

props.name: level
props.description: Use 2 only for a page-style header inside a page that already has its h1 (a pane, a tab panel). It looks the same either way.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS classes, merged onto the outer element. When two Tailwind classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the outer element.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Moves through a long list one page at a time. The current page gets the signal fill. Where there are too many pages to fit, a gap stands in for the run that's hidden.
components.useWhen: Moving through a long list or table one page at a time.

props.name: page
props.description: Counts from 1. A number outside the range is pulled back into it.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Below 1, nothing renders.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: It's never called with the page you're already on.

props.name: variant
props.description: What sits between Previous and Next: the page buttons, a 'Page 3 of 20' readout (which screen readers announce politely, without interrupting, when it changes), or a page Select. Only use 'select' up to a few dozen pages.

props.name: siblings
props.description: How many pages show on each side of the current page, for 'numbered'.

props.name: showFirstLast
props.description: Adds First page and Last page icon buttons at the ends. Like Previous and Next, they go aria-disabled at the first and last page.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Shows Previous and Next as text buttons ('Previous', 'Next') with their chevrons, instead of icons alone.

props.name: showJump
props.description: Adds a 'Go to page' field. Enter or Go jumps there, and a number past either end goes to that end.

props.name: totalItems
props.description: Together with pageSize, it shows the range on view ('21–40 of 400') at the start and lays the control out as a table footer.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Items per page, used for the range text and the rows-per-page Select.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Together with pageSize, it shows a rows-per-page Select. When it fires, reset page to 1: the old page may not exist any more.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: The rows-per-page choices.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the nav landmark (a region screen readers can jump to).

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the nav element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the nav DOM node (the element in the page).

components.name: PromptInput
components.summary: The box where a person writes to an assistant. It grows to fit the text, has one Send/Stop button and can show suggestions. Enter sends, and Shift+Enter starts a new line.
components.useWhen: The message box under a ChatThread.

props.name: label
props.description: Required. Names the box. It's hidden on screen.

props.name: value
props.description: Required. The draft. Controlled, meaning your page holds it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Required.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Required. Fires on Enter, Send or a suggestion, and never with a blank draft. Clear the draft here.

props.name: busy
props.description: Send turns into Stop, and Enter sends nothing.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Runs on Stop, and on Escape in the box while busy.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Ready-made prompts shown as chips. Clicking one submits it.

props.name: editableSuggestions
props.description: Clicking a suggestion puts its text in the box to edit instead of sending it. Use it when a person will likely change the prompt first. The chips then stay usable while busy.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty box.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be typed or sent. Say why somewhere nearby.

props.name: hint
props.description: The line under the box, which is also its description.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the form.

components.name: QuantityStepper
components.summary: A whole number between a lowest and a highest value, with a button on each side. It follows the spinbutton pattern (the standard recipe for a number you nudge up and down), so the keyboard can do everything from inside the field.
components.useWhen: A whole number between real limits, such as a quantity in a cart.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the field and both buttons ("Decrease Speed loader quantity"). Leave it out inside a FormField, which sets it from its own label. Outside one it is required, and `division-ds check` flags a missing one.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (your page holds it).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when the component holds the value itself (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the final value, pulled inside the limits: after a button click, an arrow key, Home/End, or when typing is finished by leaving the field or pressing Enter.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest allowed value.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest allowed value.

props.name: step
props.description: The size of each step the value snaps to, counted from min.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and both buttons.

props.name: inputSize
props.description: Size of the field and buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Combined with the root classes. Where Tailwind utility classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the field.

props.name: id
props.description: The field's id, so a FormField's label and error text can point at it. FormField sets it.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ids of the help and error text, set on the field so screen readers read them out. FormField sets it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as invalid: aria-invalid and the invalid border. FormField sets it when there is an error.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required. FormField sets it.

components.name: Rating
components.summary: A score out of five, either shown or collected. The display is one image that a screen reader reads as one sentence. The input is a radio group, because picking a rating means picking one value.
components.useWhen: Showing or collecting a score out of five.

props.name: value (Rating)
props.description: From 0 up to max, rounded to the nearest half for both the drawing and what screen readers say.

props.name: max (Rating)
props.description: Number of stars.

props.name: label (Rating)
props.description: What is being rated, read out as "<label> rated 4.5 out of 5".

props.name: showValue (Rating)
props.description: Prints the rounded value beside the stars, aria-hidden.

props.name: size (Rating)
props.description: Star size.

props.name: className (Rating)
props.description: Combined with the root classes. Where Tailwind utility classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref (Rating)
props.description: Passed through to the root span.

props.name: label (RatingInput)
props.description: Required. The radiogroup's name, for example "Rate the Prism holo sight".

props.name: value (RatingInput)
props.description: The selected value, when your page holds it (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue (RatingInput)
props.description: Starting value when the component holds it itself (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange (RatingInput)
props.description: Fires when a star is picked by click or arrow key.

props.name: max (RatingInput)
props.description: Number of stars.

props.name: disabled (RatingInput)
props.description: Disables every star.

props.name: className (RatingInput)
props.description: Combined with the root classes.

props.name: ref (RatingInput)
props.description: Passed through to the Radix radiogroup root. It's built straight on that, not on the Radio atom: see the anatomy row above.

components.name: Search
components.summary: A search field inside a search landmark (a region of the page that screen readers can jump straight to). Enter submits, Escape clears, and a one-key shortcut can move focus to it from anywhere on the page.
components.useWhen: Searching the content of the page that shows the results, inside a search landmark.

props.name: label
props.description: Required. The name screen readers use for the field, and for the search landmark.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, when your page holds it (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when the component holds it itself (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called whenever the value changes, clearing included.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called on Enter with the value, spaces trimmed from both ends. It isn't called for an empty query.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: One printable key, for example "/". It moves focus to the field from anywhere on the page, except while someone is typing in another text field. While the field is empty, it shows as a Kbd hint.

props.name: className
props.description: Combined with the root classes. Where Tailwind utility classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the input element.

components.name: SectionHeading
components.summary: The heading that opens a section of a page: a title under a hairline, with an optional description and an optional action. The page tells it which heading level to use, because only the page knows its own outline.
components.useWhen: Opening a section of a page, at the level that carries on the outline.

props.name: title
props.description: Required. The heading text.

props.name: level
props.description: Required, with no default. The heading level the page outline needs at this point. Leave it out and the code won't compile.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: action
props.description: A single control at the end of the row, usually a link to the full list.

props.name: index
props.description: The section's position in a numbered run of sections, drawn above the title. It's decoration and never part of the heading's name.

props.name: id
props.description: Goes on the heading element, not the wrapper, so a section can point aria-labelledby at it (that's how the section gets its name for screen readers).

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the root. Where Tailwind utility classes clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the root element.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Two to five options in one framed row, with one selected. It changes what's on screen in place. Under the hood it's a radio group: Tab stops on it once, the arrow keys move and select, and the selected option has a signal fill with ink text.
components.useWhen: Switching the view of the same content in place: Board or Table, 24 h or 7 d.

props.name: label
props.description: Required. Names the group: "View", "Range".

props.name: options
props.description: Required. Two to five.

props.name: value
props.description: Required. The selected option.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Required. Called with the new value.

props.name: size
props.description: The same height as Button's sm or md.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the group.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the group.

props.name: value (SegmentedControlOption)
props.description: Required. What onValueChange receives.

props.name: label (SegmentedControlOption)
props.description: Required. Always shown.

props.name: icon (SegmentedControlOption)
props.description: A lucide icon before the label, aria-hidden so screen readers skip it.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: One number that matters, and how it has moved. The number is the star of the show. The label is small, set in a monospaced font and kept quiet.
components.useWhen: One headline number and how it has moved. Up to four in a row.

props.name: label
props.description: The stat's name, for example "Kits dispatched".

props.name: value
props.description: Whole numbers get padded. Anything else (for example "4.2k") is shown exactly as given.

props.name: unit
props.description: Shown beside the value, for example "kg".

props.name: padTo
props.description: Pads a whole-number value to this many digits with dimmed zeros that screen readers skip (aria-hidden).

props.name: delta
props.description: value comes already formatted (for example "12%"). direction picks the arrow. sentiment picks the colour, and it doesn't depend on direction: fewer failed syncs is down, and that's positive. period is what the number is compared with, for example "last week". It's both shown and spoken.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the root classes. If two Tailwind utilities clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the root div.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Any standard div attribute, applied to the root div.

components.name: StatusTracker
components.summary: Health over time, drawn as a row of thin bars with one bar per period. The oldest is on the left. Each bar says its status in words and shows them in a tooltip when you hover over it or reach it with the keyboard. The whole row is a single Tab stop, and the arrow keys move along it.
components.useWhen: The health history of one service or device, such as uptime over 30 or 90 days.

props.name: label
props.description: Required. Names the row, for example "Uptime, last 30 days".

props.name: items
props.description: Required. Oldest first.

props.name: summary
props.description: Shown on the right of the label row, for example "99.2% up".

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Replaces the status words: Operational, Degraded, Down, No data.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the root.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the root.

props.name: id (StatusTrackerItem)
props.description: Required. A key that never changes for that item.

props.name: status (StatusTrackerItem)
props.description: Required. ok means up. warning means degraded. hostile means down or failed. neutral means no data.

props.name: label (StatusTrackerItem)
props.description: Required. The period and what happened, for example "12 Oct: 2 alerts, 14 min degraded".

props.name: statusTrackerText()
props.description: Builds the text a bar uses for its name and tooltip, for example "Degraded. 12 Oct: 2 alerts".

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Shows where someone is in a flow of several steps. Finished steps get a check mark, the current one is filled with the signal colour, and the rest wait as outlines.
components.useWhen: Showing where someone is in a flow of two to five steps.

props.name: steps
props.description: Required. { label: string; description?: string }.

props.name: current
props.description: Counts from 0. steps.length means every step is complete.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's accessible name, the name screen readers announce.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal runs in a row from sm up and stacks below it. Vertical is a column at every width, with connectors.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the root classes. If two Tailwind utilities clash, the later one wins.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the root ol.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Sections of one view, with only one visible at a time. The active tab is filled with the signal colour, the same way every other selection in the system is.
components.useWhen: Switching between equally important sections of one view.

props.name: value (Root)
props.description: The active tab, when the page controls it.

props.name: variant
props.description: How the active tab is shown (Root). 'line' underlines it, for a row inside a panel that already has lots of fills.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab that starts active, when the component manages it (Root).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the active tab changes (Root).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move between tabs (Root). Vertical also puts the list beside the panels.

props.name: activationMode
props.description: 'manual' waits for Enter or Space before switching, for panels that are slow to draw (Root).

props.name: value (Trigger)
props.description: This tab's own value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns off one tab (Trigger).

props.name: icon (Trigger)
props.description: A small symbol before the label, hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden).

props.name: count (Trigger)
props.description: A number after the label, included in the name screen readers announce.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the root classes. If two Tailwind utilities clash, the later one wins. Available on every part.

props.name: ref
props.description: Passed through to the underlying page element. Available on every part.

components.name: TimeField
components.summary: A time of day, an add-on to the date pickers. Hours and minutes are segments you type into or step with the arrow keys, like DateField; the clock button opens a list of times every step minutes. With a 12-hour clock there is an AM/PM segment. The value is 'HH:MM' on a 24-hour clock whatever is shown. Put it next to a DatePicker for a date and a time.
components.useWhen: A pickup slot, a meeting start, a shift.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the field. Leave it out inside a FormField, which sets it from its own label. Outside one it is required, and `division-ds check` flags a missing one.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, 24-hour.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when the field holds it itself.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with a whole time, or '' when emptied.

props.name: hourCycle

props.name: headingLevel

props.name: asChild (Close)

tokens.name: --spacing-1
tokens.use: 4px. The gap between an icon and its label, or two tightly bound marks.

tokens.name: --spacing-2
tokens.use: 8px. The gap between related items in a row: chips, a label and its value.

tokens.name: --spacing-3
tokens.use: 12px. The gap between sibling controls, such as two buttons.

tokens.name: --spacing-4
tokens.use: 16px. Default padding inside a control or a compact panel; the gap between fields.

tokens.name: --spacing-6
tokens.use: 24px. Padding inside a Card; the gap between groups in a form.

tokens.name: --spacing-8
tokens.use: 32px. The gap between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: --spacing-12
tokens.use: 48px. The gap between sections of a page.

tokens.name: --spacing-16
tokens.use: 64px. The page gutter from the large breakpoint, and the gap around a hero block.

tokens.name: --duration-fast
tokens.use: 120ms. Hover and press feedback: colour and border changes on a control.

tokens.name: --duration-base
tokens.use: 180ms. The default for anything that is not hover feedback: a menu or tooltip entering, a collapse.

tokens.name: --duration-slow
tokens.use: 320ms. A larger change: a section expanding, a progress bar filling, the Switch thumb settling into shape after it arrives.

tokens.name: --duration-stepped
tokens.use: 180ms, run in steps. The Button's stepped hover arrival. Used by .transition-stepped only.

tokens.name: --ease-snap
tokens.use: The default easing curve: quick out, soft landing. Use it for every transition that is not a physical object changing shape.

tokens.name: --ease-accelerate
tokens.use: Starts slow, gathers speed and stops at the end. For a small object that travels into a boundary and gives slightly against it (the Switch thumb). Not for anything that should land softly: that is --ease-snap.

tokens.name: --color-surface-base
tokens.use: The page background, and the opaque fill of every form and overlay. Start here: text and control colours are measured against it.

tokens.name: --color-surface-sunken
tokens.use: The opaque fill of a control you type or pick in (Input, Textarea, Select), and of small opaque surfaces: Kbd, Tag, Tooltip, menus, toasts. Not a card.

tokens.name: --color-surface-raised
tokens.use: The translucent fill of a Card or panel sitting on the page. Use the Card component; do not paint it by hand, and avoid nesting raised inside raised.

tokens.name: --color-surface-scrim
tokens.use: The dimming layer behind a Dialog, Sheet or CommandPalette. Those components paint it; nothing else should.

tokens.name: --color-border-hairline
tokens.use: A quiet divider or panel edge that carries no information: row separators, card outlines.

tokens.name: --color-border-hairline-strong
tokens.use: A stronger decorative rule: table header underlines, section rules. Still decorative, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: --color-border-control
tokens.use: The boundary of an interactive control at rest (Input, Select, secondary Button). The one border that has to be seen to find the control.

tokens.name: --color-border-selection
tokens.use: The boundary of the small selection controls at rest: Checkbox, Radio, Switch track.

tokens.name: --color-text-primary
tokens.use: Body text, headings, values. The default text colour.

tokens.name: --color-text-secondary
tokens.use: Supporting text beside primary text: descriptions, help text, metadata. Keep it at 14px or larger.

tokens.name: --color-text-muted
tokens.use: The quietest readable text: captions, timestamps, disabled-looking labels. Not for anything the user must read to act.

tokens.name: --color-text-placeholder
tokens.use: Placeholder text inside a control, on surface.sunken. Only there.

tokens.name: --color-text-label
tokens.use: Group labels that head a list of items (the command palette's group titles). Uppercase mono, never body text.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-fill
tokens.use: A solid block in the brand colour, exactly as chosen: the primary Button, IconButton, a solid signal Badge. Put accent.signal.ink on it, never text.primary. Never use it as the only sign of a state; use accent.signal.indicator.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-text
tokens.use: Orange text or icon on a surface: a current nav item, an emphasised figure, a link accent.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-ink
tokens.use: Text and icons on accent.signal.fill.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-indicator
tokens.use: The accent where colour alone shows a state or value: a checked control, Switch on, Progress, Slider, Rating stars, the current item in Sidebar, Navbar, Tabs, SegmentedControl, Stepper and highlighted menu rows. Put accent.signal.indicator-ink on it.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-indicator-ink
tokens.use: Text and icons on accent.signal.indicator.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-wash
tokens.use: The faint orange hover wash under a nav item or an inactive tab.

tokens.name: --color-accent-signal-glow
tokens.use: The faint shadow of an interactive Card on hover and focus. Used by the Card component only.

tokens.name: --color-accent-hostile-fill
tokens.use: A solid block for danger or failure: the danger Button, a solid hostile Badge. Put accent.hostile.ink on it.

tokens.name: --color-accent-hostile-text
tokens.use: Error and destructive text or icon on a surface: field errors, an invalid border, a failed status.

tokens.name: --color-accent-hostile-ink
tokens.use: Text and icons on accent.hostile.fill.

tokens.name: --color-accent-ok-fill
tokens.use: A solid block for success or a healthy state. Put accent.ok.ink on it.

tokens.name: --color-accent-ok-text
tokens.use: Success text or icon on a surface: a positive delta, an in-stock status.

tokens.name: --color-accent-ok-ink
tokens.use: Text and icons on accent.ok.fill.

tokens.name: --color-accent-info-fill
tokens.use: A solid block for neutral information. Put accent.info.ink on it.

tokens.name: --color-accent-info-text
tokens.use: Informational text or icon on a surface: an in-progress status, a note.

tokens.name: --color-accent-info-ink
tokens.use: Text and icons on accent.info.fill.

tokens.name: --color-accent-warning-fill
tokens.use: A solid block for a warning or a degraded state. Put accent.warning.ink on it.

tokens.name: --color-accent-warning-text
tokens.use: Warning text or icon on a surface: a pending or degraded status.

tokens.name: --color-accent-warning-ink
tokens.use: Text and icons on accent.warning.fill.

tokens.name: --color-numeral-pad
tokens.use: The dimmed leading zeros of a hero numeral. Decorative; never text that has to be read.

tokens.name: --color-ai-text
tokens.use: Text or an icon that marks something as made by AI: the AiLabel mark, the AI glyph in a field an AI filled. Always beside a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: --color-ai-border
tokens.use: The boundary of a form field whose value an AI filled and the person has not changed. Input and Textarea paint it from aiValue; do not paint it by hand.

tokens.name: --color-ai-wash
tokens.use: The faint tint inside a field an AI filled, laid over the control fill. Input and Textarea paint it; nothing else should.

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring
tokens.use: The keyboard focus outline. Use it only in focus-visible:outline-[var(--color-focus-ring)], with a 2px outline and a 2px offset.

tokens.name: --color-chart-series-1
tokens.use: The first data series in a chart. A graphic colour, never text. ChartPanel applies it.

tokens.name: --color-chart-series-2
tokens.use: The second data series in a chart. A graphic colour, never text. There is no third: split the chart.

tokens.name: --component-control-height-sm
tokens.use: Height of a small control (32px): a compact Button, an Input in a dense row.

tokens.name: --component-control-height-md
tokens.use: Height of a default control (40px). What Button, Input and Select use unless told otherwise.

tokens.name: --component-control-height-lg
tokens.use: Height of a large control (48px): the main action of a page or a touch-first form.

tokens.name: --component-control-border-rest
tokens.use: A text control's border at rest. Set by Input, Textarea and Select.

tokens.name: --component-control-border-hover
tokens.use: A text control's border under the pointer.

tokens.name: --component-control-border-invalid
tokens.use: A control's border when its field has an error. Set through the invalid prop, which FormField passes.

tokens.name: --component-control-border-selection
tokens.use: The border of Checkbox, Radio and Switch at rest.

tokens.name: --component-control-border-selection-hover
tokens.use: The border of Checkbox, Radio and Switch under the pointer.

tokens.name: --component-control-border-disabled
tokens.use: A disabled control's border.

tokens.name: --component-control-indicator-checked
tokens.use: The colour of a selection control in its chosen state: a checked Checkbox, a selected Radio, an on Switch.

tokens.name: --component-control-progress-fill-ok
tokens.use: A Progress bar's fill at tone ok.

tokens.name: --component-control-progress-fill-warning
tokens.use: A Progress bar's fill at tone warning.

tokens.name: --component-control-progress-fill-hostile
tokens.use: A Progress bar's fill at tone hostile.

tokens.name: --component-control-fill-rest
tokens.use: A text control's fill.

tokens.name: --component-control-fill-disabled
tokens.use: A disabled control's fill.

tokens.name: --component-control-text-rest
tokens.use: The text typed into a control.

tokens.name: --component-control-text-placeholder
tokens.use: A control's placeholder text.

tokens.name: --component-control-text-disabled
tokens.use: A disabled control's text.

tokens.use: The danger Button's label.

tokens.name: --component-button-secondary-text
tokens.use: The secondary Button's label.

tokens.use: The ghost Button's label at rest.
